note: One case input per rules-corpus sample, used by scripts/measure-rule-safety.mjs through the product's own fillPrompt. Without an input the corpus prompts ask the model to invent the thing it is being asked about, and a first run showed what that costs: the whitespace sample -- a scheduling assistant with no request to schedule -- agreed with itself on 1 of 6 pairs, so the method could say nothing about a rule that only collapses blank lines. These are written to be answerable and dull: a case whose answer is a judgement call measures the case, not the rule.
